## OpenCode Guardian v0.18.0

Comprehensive security, isolation, redaction, snapshot, and lifecycle hardening across five independent static & adversarial audit rounds (R1–R5), provider-agnostic dynamic MCP tool inspection, and full live OpenCode `v2.4.1` verification across all 14 discipline rules and multi-rule batching.

### Security & Policy Hardening
- **Provider-Agnostic MCP Tool Inspection (`src/preflight.ts`, `src/tool-input.ts`, `src/evidence.ts`, `src/rules/*`):**
  - Removed all hardcoded third-party MCP provider names, references, comments, and fixtures across source, tests, docs, and distribution artifacts.
  - Replaced provider-specific lists with dynamic `mcp__<provider>__<action>` normalization (`extractToolAction`), preserving full preflight, shell-risk, file-mutation, and evidence inspection for any MCP provider.
- **Global Security Floor & Project/Mesh Isolation (`src/engine.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/bridge.ts`):**
  - Hardened `allowProjectOverrides: false` security floors across `enabled`, `preflight.enabled`, `preflight.mode`, `secrets.enabled`, remediation/iteration budgets, and rule severities.
  - Enforced verified project-local scope isolation across `session.context`, `session.prompt`, `tool.execute.before`, `tool.execute.after`, `shell.create.before`, and RPC handlers; prevented disabled projects from mutating sibling mesh peer state.
  - Scoped Guardian RPC intervention clearing to owner `"opencode-guardian"` so sibling mesh peers' active interventions are never overwritten.
- **Multi-Layer Secret Redaction & Preflight Improvements (`src/secrets/patterns.ts`, `src/secrets/sanitizer.ts`, `src/rules/no-secrets.ts`, `src/preflight.ts`, `src/edit-integrity.ts`):**
  - Extended `CONNECTION_STRING_PASSWORD_REGEX` to cover `http(s)://user:pass@host` and database schemes while excluding `?` and `#` from userinfo classes so normal URLs with ports and `@` in query/fragment parameters are never corrupted.
  - Added object key and `Error` non-standard own-property key sanitization with unconditional collision-safe key suffixing.
  - Updated `security/no-secrets` `customSensitiveKeys` scanning to scan files `<= 640 KiB` contiguously and cover head `512 KiB` + tail `128 KiB` on larger files, eliminating blind seams.
  - Hardened preflight `move`/`copy` handling with normalized null-device detection (`isNullDevice`: `/dev/null`, `//dev/null`, `/dev/./null`, `NUL`) and removed the `>2 MiB` early bypass in `findTruncationPlaceholder`.

### Runtime, Evidence & Subagent Lifecycle
- **Subagent Handoff, Lease & Background Job Integrity (`src/index.ts`, `src/bridge.ts`, `src/agent-capability.ts`):**
  - Re-resolved agent write capability on every round inside `finalizeSubagentHandoff` (querying live `context.session.get` first so mid-handoff `session.agent.selected` downgrades stop further remediation rounds cleanly).
  - Restricted `[TASK OUTCOME]` terminal status propagation to an explicit allowlist (`TERMINAL_SUBAGENT_STATUSES`) using O(N) trailing non-empty line parsing (`lastNonEmptyLine`), preventing mid-body quote spoofing and quadratic regex backtracking.
  - Added `leaseToken` ownership validation to `acquireSessionLease` / `renewSessionLease` and acquired `active_remediation` leases before `await sendPrompt` with abort-safe cleanup and budget rollback on mesh `user_interaction` blocks.
  - Added timestamped TTL pruning (`pruneStaleBackgroundJobs`) and `"__anonymous__"` tracking for keyless background jobs across `experimental.idle` and `experimental.job.updated`.
  - Kept awaited handoff deadline, interrupt grace, and TUI RPC timeout timers properly ref'd for Node 22.x event-loop compatibility.
  - Bounded directory caches with soft-64 / hard-128 eviction (`setBoundedDirectoryEntry`).

releases.name: opencode-guardian v0.17.9
releases.body:
## Fixed
- **Eliminated false-positive `Unresolved command failure` remediations on aborted/interrupted tools and `opencode service restart` (#4):**
  - `src/evidence.ts` now classifies OpenCode V2 aborted/interrupted tool outcomes (`error: { type: "aborted", message: "Tool execution interrupted..." }`, `"Step interrupted"`, explicit cancellations, and structurally self-interrupting service restarts like `opencode service restart`) as `status: "unknown"` (`outcomeReason: "cancelled"`) instead of `status: "failure"`.
  - Verification integrity is preserved: aborted test/build runs never count as passing evidence (`integrity/no-unverified-claims` and explicit `task/completion-gate` verification requirements still enforce), and genuine CLI errors (e.g. non-zero exit with invalid flags) still register as failures.
  - Hardened `normalizeV2Messages` (`src/index.ts`) so `type: "user"` messages without a string `text` field (e.g. attachment-only prompts) always establish a fresh human turn boundary.
  - Added regression test suite `tests/issue4-service-restart-aborted.test.mjs`.

## Verification
- `npm test`: **852 / 852 PASS**
- `npm run typecheck:strict` & `npm run lint`: **PASS** (0 warnings, 0 errors across 123 files)
- `sandbox/smoke-test.mjs` & `sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`: **18 / 18 PASS**

- `npm audit --omit=dev`: **0 vulnerabilities**

releases.name: opencode-guardian v0.17.8
releases.body:
## Fixed
- **Eliminated spurious Guardian triggers when closing and reopening OpenCode:**
  - Scoped `GuardEngine.inspect()` around synthetic peer-plugin wake messages (`opencode-mesh.kind === "wake" | "notice" | "status"` and `hi-internal === "attention" | "notify" | "wake"`), so startup attention wakes (such as `opencode-hi` waking an idle session on OpenCode open) inspect only work performed *after* the peer wake instead of re-auditing hours-old historical tool failures in `task/completion-gate`, while still catching brand-new violations or failures introduced after the wake.
  - Added restart-safe persisted remediation budget accounting (`src/engine.ts`, `src/state.ts`): after a server restart or plugin hot-reload wipes in-memory session state, persisted synthetic `[opencode-guardian remediation]` messages already in the current turn count against `remediationBudget` / `iterationBudget` (while rejecting spoofed non-synthetic user text).
  - Added regression suite `tests/v0178-restart-wake-guard.test.mjs`.

## Verification
- `npm test`: **847 / 847 PASS**
- `npm run typecheck:strict` & `npm run lint`: **PASS** (0 warnings, 0 errors across 122 files)

releases.name: opencode-guardian v0.17.7
releases.body:
## Fixed
- **Eliminated `TrailingAssistantHistoryError` session crashes when `notifications.transcript: true` is enabled on OpenCode v2.4.1:**
  - Removed all `context.session.synthetic({ resume: false })` calls for display-only `visible` notices. In OpenCode v2.4.1, `session.synthetic` always admits a row into `session_inbox`, which `SessionRunner.drain` promotes after the assistant's `finish: "stop"` turn and executes as a new LLM step; stripping it in `session.context` left `event.messages` ending on `role: "assistant"` and triggered `NativeAnthropicLocalRefusal` / `TrailingAssistantHistoryError`.
  - `notifications.transcript: true` now delivers the same secret-redacted per-finding bullets (`ruleId`, `pattern`, `[filePath]`, `description`, `Action:`) purely through the OpenCode V2 TUI `session.composer.top` RPC snapshot with multi-line rendering and a 15 s readable TTL (still clearing immediately on `[dismiss]` or human prompt), with zero `session_inbox` mutations.
  - Added a trailing-assistant defense-in-depth guard in `session.context`.

## Verification
- `npm test`: **843 / 843 PASS**
- `npm run typecheck:strict` & `npm run lint`: **PASS** (0 warnings, 0 errors)
- `sandbox/smoke-test.mjs` & `sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`: **18 / 18 PASS**
- `sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs` (Node 26.13.1, Bun 1.4.4, OpenCode v2.4.1): **10 / 10 PASS**

releases.name: v0.17.6 — Detailed Secret-Safe Chat Transcript Notices
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Detailed Chat Transcript Notices (`notifications.transcript: true`):** Added `formatGuardianTranscriptNotice` and `GuardianInterventionDetail` (`src/toast.ts`, `src/index.ts`) so opt-in model-invisible chat entries include distinct intervention headers (`⊘ BLOCKED`, `↻ REMEDIATION`, `⏹ STREAM STOP`, `▲ WARNING`), deduplicated per-finding bullets (`ruleId`, `pattern`, optional `[filePath]`, and bounded `description`), and an explicit `Action:` line.
- **Secret-Safe Redaction:** Every free-text detail field passes through `sanitizeString` before posting so raw secrets and raw model text never leak into the transcript.
- **Config Visibility:** Surfaced `Chat transcript notices: enabled|disabled` in `/guardian config`.

## Verification
- `npm test`: **842 / 842 PASS** (including 2 new regression tests in `tests/v0172-transcript-notice.test.mjs`)
- `npm run typecheck:strict` & `npm run lint`: **PASS** (0 warnings, 0 errors across 121 files)
- `sandbox/smoke-test.mjs` & `sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`: **18 / 18 PASS**
- `sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs`: **10 / 10 PASS** (Node 26.13.1, Bun 1.4.4, OpenCode `v2.4.1`)
- `npm audit --omit=dev` (0 vulns), `scripts/check-dev-audit.mjs`, `scripts/check-docs.mjs`, `npm pack --dry-run`: **PASS**
